Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000467": Team Dune sits on the fourth floor.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000464": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000450": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000420" [decision]: Team Dune has switched to a monthly game day.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000406": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the catalog service is not Team Boreal's service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000389": As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000387": Dashboards and alerts for the resizer are being repointed as of 2025-04-29.  (about: resizer)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000368": On 2025-04-18, Team Atlas reported that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000365" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000324" [decision]: On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000268": As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000266" [constraint]: The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000259": Team Dune owns the catalog service as of the 2025-03-20 ownership transfer.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000255": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000228": The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover.  (about: Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000129": Team Dune owns the reporting service.  (about: Team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000053": As of January 2025, Team Dune consists of Farah alone.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000048": Farah runs Team Dune solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
